items.title: Kroger (KR) Rolls Out Combined Grocery And Prescription Delivery Nationwide
items.summary: Kroger (NYSE: KR) has rolled out a combined grocery and prescription delivery service through Instacart across nearly all Kroger-owned banners. The new option lets customers place a single Instacart order for both groceries and eligible prescriptions. The launch supports Kroger's omni-channel approach and aims to deepen customer loyalty in digital grocery and health services.
